laws: A residue specification exposes identity, chirality, and protection metadata without assigning empirical values.
description: A generic residue record keeps chemical identity, chirality, and protection metadata explicit and type-safe.

laws: A peptide target carries a nonempty residue list stored N-to-C.
The C-to-N coupling schedule is the reverse of all residues except the C-terminal residue.
The schedule length plus the initially loaded C-terminal residue equals the target length.
description: A nonempty peptide target stores its public sequence orientation and derives the solid-phase coupling order from carried nonemptiness evidence.

laws: A resin state exposes its growing N-to-C chain, N-terminal protection state, linker, resin loading, and reactive-site amount.
Resin loading is a nonnegative ChemistryLib Quantity with the ChemicalDimension amount-of-substance per Physlib mass dimension.
Reactive-site amount is ChemistryLib.Foundations.Amount; the state introduces no parallel unit or quantity representation.
description: The resin-bound state uses released ChemistryLib dimensions, quantities, and Amount directly while separating structural sequence semantics from empirical values.

laws: The abstract sequence-state wash transition preserves the growing chain.
description: The abstract wash transition has no sequence-level effect; it makes no transport, removal-efficiency, or purification claim.

laws: The abstract deprotection transition changes the N-terminal protection state to deprotected while preserving chain, linker, resin loading, and reactive-site amount.
description: A model transition updates only the protection field and does not assert that an experimental deprotection succeeded.

laws: A coupling operation records incoming residue, before state, and after state without asserting success.
Successful-coupling, no-deletion, and no-epimerization hypotheses are separate obligations and together imply that the intended incoming residue is prepended to the N-to-C chain.
The state machine does not redefine reaction networks, stoichiometric matrices, units, or quantities; the separate stoichiometry adapter reuses released ChemistryLib declarations.
description: A coupling attempt and three independent predicates enforce the evidence boundary between protocol intent and chemical outcome.

laws: A full-cycle attempt composes abstract deprotection, wash, and coupling at the sequence-state level.
Under explicit successful-coupling, no-deletion, and no-epimerization hypotheses, one full cycle adds exactly the intended residue.
description: The full-cycle theorem is conditional and contains no inference from a protocol record to experimental success.

laws: A trace connects coupling attempts in C-to-N schedule order from an initially loaded C-terminal residue.
If every attempt explicitly satisfies successful-coupling, no-deletion, and no-epimerization, the final N-to-C chain equals the target.
The number of coupling attempts plus the initially loaded residue equals the target length.
description: Finite-list reasoning proves target construction and cycle count only from a connected trace whose outcomes meet all three explicit hypotheses.

laws: A coarse coupling bookkeeping network is defined directly as a ChemistryLib.ReactionNetwork whose complexes are ChemistryLib.Complex values; no parallel CRN representation is introduced.
Released ChemistryLib reactionVector and stoichiometricMatrix give the growing-chain, incoming-residue, and extended-chain coefficients minus one, minus one, and plus one.
Weights n, one, and n plus one form a released ChemistryLib IsConservationLaw for residue-count bookkeeping.

Coupling amounts, dimensioned quantities, and concentrations reuse ChemistryLib.Foundations.Amount, ChemistryLib.Units.Quantity, ChemistryLib.Units.ChemicalDimension, and ChemistryLib.Foundations.ConcentrationProfile directly.
The bookkeeping network omits reagents and byproducts, and its residue-count conservation theorem is not a molecular-mass conservation or complete reaction-mechanism claim.
description: A thin AFPS adapter instantiates released ChemistryLib CRN, stoichiometry, dimension, quantity, amount, and concentration APIs without claiming a full chemical mechanism.
